items.author: goospie.bsky.social
items.context: Did you know i was always a console kid? The first game that ever got me to play PC was Celeste, which i'm actually playing as we speak. I saw the Switch version of it at Fnac for €35, then checked Steam and the summer sale had it at €5 + €2 OST. Best deal i've gotten in my life
items.text: Great find, and Celeste is a lovely game to start PC with. Wishlisting on Steam is an easy way to catch a sale like that.

items.author: saryaart.bsky.social
items.context: I'll have to check, I was looking for overcooked-like games because she enjoys the co-op, chaotic play, but doesn't like games with battles or anything of the short. Basically, a family game I'd say. Thanks!
items.text: Moving Out is worth a look: chaotic co-op where you move furniture, no battles at all. The Steam page shows which co-op modes a game supports before you buy.
